description: Eight town-improvement proposals for fictional Milldale (the same universe as the sibling repos). evidence_for/evidence_against are 0-5 fixture facts; a proposal is AMBIGUOUS when the margin is under the CLEAR_MARGIN (2). Three items are deliberately ambiguous - they are the ones an instruction-following judge will flip on.

proposals.title: Repair the river footbridge
proposals.pitch: Reopen the closed footbridge; the detour adds twenty minutes for the east side.
proposals.objection: Repair quotes vary widely and the contractor pool is thin this season.

proposals.title: Build a glass gazebo on the square
proposals.pitch: A showpiece for the square, usable in winter.
proposals.objection: Glazing costs dwarf the bandstand's entire budget and the square floods in spring.

proposals.title: Lantern lighting on the river trail
proposals.pitch: Evening walkers currently turn back at dusk.
proposals.objection: Solar lanterns underperform under the tree canopy in autumn.

proposals.title: Dredge the skating pond
proposals.pitch: Silt is shrinking the usable ice each winter.
proposals.objection: Dredging spoil disposal is unpriced and the pond may refill with silt in two seasons.

proposals.title: Restore the town hall bell
proposals.pitch: Silent for a decade; restoration is mostly labor.
proposals.objection: The bell tower masonry needs its own survey before any weight swings up there.

proposals.title: Pave Orchard Lane
proposals.pitch: The gravel washes out every storm; carts lose produce.
proposals.objection: Paving invites faster through-traffic past the school gate.

proposals.title: Open the old quarry as a swimming pool
proposals.pitch: The flooded quarry is already the unofficial swimming spot.
proposals.objection: Depth is unsurveyed, access is a scramble, and no lifeguard budget exists.

proposals.title: Add a reading annex to the library
proposals.pitch: The reading room overflows on winter afternoons.
proposals.objection: The annex footprint takes half the herb garden the volunteers planted.
